trap: A verification battery written as one single-quoted zsh -fc string under set -e reports ok for not having checked.
mechanism: An apostrophe inside the string closes it and truncates the battery silently; negated pipelines (! cmd) are exempt from ERR_EXIT, so bare assertions cannot fail; skips print ok:.
avoid: Predicates are functions in one language with three results (pass/fail/skip) and every skip listed; the gate writes last_gate_run with skipped_reasons.
evidence: spec §1 R4 and failure 3; scripts/check.zsh in the old path

trap: Sourcing the old lib.zsh from a checkout silently measured the installed copy.
mechanism: lib.zsh force-overrode AI_LITELLM_CONFIG and the harness dir to the installed prefix unless AI_LITELLM_HOME pointed at the checkout; three confident conclusions in one session were wrong because of it.
avoid: There is no installed copy any more (D9). Every command prints copy.* (checkout, commit, dirty, state); state which copy you measured before reporting a dynamic measurement.

trap: Promoting a discovered model to a packaged route deadlocked the old installer on a duplicate.
mechanism: The discovered and the packaged declaration named the same model; the installer refused the duplicate and could not proceed.
avoid: A packaged route shadows its discovered twin at read time and the next sync drops the twin (§6); route.unique is checked after every write.

trap: Hand-computing Claude Code's context budget, or mistaking the 200K cost guardrail for a context window.
mechanism: The old derivation lived in four implementations in three languages; the 200000 figure was a spend guardrail using a 4-chars-per-token estimate, not a window.
avoid: cost_model.context is min(declared, verified) computed by schemas.observed.compute_context; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS is set from it at launch; never arithmetic on a remembered context size.

trap: The old gate needed port 4000 free and failed with the advice 'run sync' when a proxy held it; that proxy and oMLX on :8000 were shared by other sessions.
mechanism: check.zsh isolated HOME but not the port; the error text pointed at the wrong cause.
avoid: The proxy is stopped for good (2026-09-08). Never restart oMLX on :8000 to run a check — it evicts a loaded model every consumer pays to reload; the agent-on gate uses an ephemeral mock port.

trap: Claude Code's total_cost_usd is its own price table, not what the route cost.
mechanism: It reported $0.24 for a free local model; a gateway that copied it would fabricate spend.
avoid: cost.not_copied: no L2 field is sourced from total_cost_usd; cost_usd comes from the route's price snapshot at launch, and is "unknown" when a turn's price cannot be restored.

trap: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1 does not list the bound source's catalog.
mechanism: Claude Code 2.1.263 fetches /v1/models?limit=1000 and keeps only ids matching /(claude|anthropic)/i: 0 on local sources, 27 paid Anthropic models on OpenRouter — the escape hatch the tier pin exists to close.
avoid: Discovery is off by default (D8); --discover opts in knowingly.

trap: Exporting the source key as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN puts it in every Bash-tool child, the model's printenv and the on-disk transcript.
mechanism: Claude Code passes its environment to tool subprocesses and records command output in the transcript.
avoid: The launcher writes the key to a per-launch 0600 file and hands Claude Code an apiKeyHelper; every source's auth_env, the routing denylist and every ANTHROPIC_*/CLAUDE_* variable except the output cap are scrubbed; credential.not_in_child_env checks it for every route on every launch. Measured NONE in both key-supply modes on 2026-09-08.
evidence: spec §1.1c, D2; Plan B acceptance step 5

trap: exo's launchd daemon took over the Thunderbolt service and reverted static TB IPs to DHCP mid-benchmark, breaking rank 1 of the oMLX tensor-parallel pair.
mechanism: exo manages networking on the link that oMLX tensor-parallel (jaccl ring, 13.86 GB/s) uses.
avoid: If exo returns it must not manage Thunderbolt networking; the exo source row stays unmeasured until then (S3).

trap: Claude Code 2.1.263 keeps only the last --settings on its command line.
mechanism: A user --settings after the launcher's displaced the apiKeyHelper file: 'Not logged in · Please run /login'.
avoid: The launcher folds a user --settings object into the per-launch settings file on a keyed route (its apiKeyHelper wins, with a warning) and passes exactly one --settings; on a keyless route the user's flag passes through.
evidence: Plan B acceptance step 4, fix F1 (commit e2d079f)

trap: Claude Code records API errors as assistant turns with model <synthetic> and zero usage.
mechanism: 429s, provider errors and 'prompt too long' appear as type: assistant lines with a message.id; priced naively they make a run's cost unknown and can record a zero baseline as measured.
avoid: read_transcript skips <synthetic> lines whose usage is all zero; a zero first request is unmeasured (None), never 0.
evidence: Plan B final review, fix item 1 (commit 0b7a962); 67 transcripts under ~/.claude/projects carried them

trap: A `python -m agent_on` shim run from inside another checkout runs that checkout's package, not the shim's.
mechanism: `-m` puts the current directory first on sys.path, ahead of PYTHONPATH; the fresh-clone acceptance launch reported copy.checkout = the cwd's checkout, not the clone's.
avoid: bin/agent-on execs `python -P -m agent_on` (Python ≥ 3.11); tests/agent_on/test_shim.py runs the shim from a directory holding a decoy agent_on package. Read the copy: line before believing a measurement.
evidence: Plan D acceptance 2026-09-09, fresh-clone step; fix in this commit

avoid: Give Codex the key as a static `http_headers = { Authorization = "Bearer …" }` in a per-launch 0600 config.toml under a per-launch CODEX_HOME that the launcher removes after exit; never env_key (the key would reach every shell-tool child).
evidence: Spike S7 2026-09-09; observations record on openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.2 the same day
mechanism: The documented helper (a local command printing a JSON object of headers) was ignored for a custom model_provider with wire_api responses — tried as `cat <file>` and as an executable script.
trap: Codex 0.153.4 does not apply http_headers_helper from config.toml: the request goes out without the header and the provider answers 401.

avoid: exo is declared-only (discover = false in routes.toml) and the loaded model is a packaged route; add another exo route only after the cluster session has loaded it (`exo run <model_id>`).
evidence: Plan E acceptance 2026-09-09: sync discovered 126 exo routes with one model loaded; status listed 142 routes.
mechanism: route.served is “wire_model in the catalog”, which is the right test for oMLX (the catalog is what is loaded) and OpenRouter (every listed model answers) but not for exo, whose catalog is an index of downloadable models; a launch on an unloaded exo route would trigger a download or fail.
trap: exo’s GET /v1/models lists the 126 models it can download, not the ones it has loaded; discovering from it yields routes that are “served” in name only, and one that is.

avoid: qualify budgets 512 output tokens for the forced-tool probe (Plan E fix); treat a 200 without stop_reason as a truncated reply, never as a passed gate; on exo prefer thinking: {type: disabled} for short probes when the model is Qwen3.
evidence: Plan E 2026-09-09 09:49 KST on exo/mlx-community/Qwen3-0.6B-8bit; the cluster session’s source reading of runner.py (tool parser comes from the chat template: Qwen3 <tool_call> detected, Llama-3 <|python_tag|> not)
mechanism: exo v1.0.71 adapters/claude.py: a Qwen3 model with thinking on spends the first ~130 output tokens thinking; a request with max_tokens 128 ends mid-block and the response object is emitted without stop_reason/usage instead of stop_reason max_tokens. At 512 the same request returns [thinking, text, tool_use] with stop_reason tool_use.
trap: exo’s Anthropic wire returns HTTP 200 with no stop_reason and no usage when max_tokens is exhausted inside a thinking block.

avoid: Treat qualify as transport evidence for the probes it sends; a launch is the only proof of the harness’s own request shape. Candidate seventh gate: replay a messages[] item with role system and expect 200 — added to knowledge, not yet to qualify.
evidence: Plan E follow-up 2026-09-09; route exo/mlx-community/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct-4bit qualified 6/6 at 10:33, launch failed 10:34
found_by: Plan E follow-up (real launch on exo)
mechanism: exo v1.0.71 ClaudeMessagesRequest validates messages[].role as the literal user|assistant (Pydantic literal_error at body.messages.1.role, input system); oMLX and OpenRouter accept the same request. Measured 2026-09-09 10:34 KST: claude-on exovl -p → API Error 422, 0 turns.
trap: exo’s /v1/messages returns 422 for a messages[] item with role "system", which Claude Code 2.1.265 sends on its first request; the six fidelity gates never send that shape, so a 6/6 route can still fail the harness at turn one.

avoid: Do not run long multi-turn Claude Code sessions on exo; agent-on only removes its own per-launch $STATE/run/<id>/ and issues no DELETE to exo, so nothing here caps exo memory. Prefer short -p tasks or a small/fast model; the cluster session is adding a turn/context cap on exo Claude Code sessions.
evidence: srv-cluster (mac-cluster-66) report 2026-09-10 01:08 KST correlating exo pid 80670 RSS growth with the shim beta=true folded-system-msg log; agent-on side: exit 0, 14 turns, 64 min (observations-… on exo VL-32B).
mechanism: Claude Code resends the whole growing transcript each turn (54K-token baseline prefill + per-turn growth); exo holds KV cache for it, so runner RSS climbs monotonically. Measured 2026-09-09 11:03–11:33 KST: claude-on exovl (Qwen3-VL-32B, 14 turns, ~64 min) grew the exo runner 102→196 GB and the cluster session recorded 13 jetsam dialogs on rick.
trap: A real Claude Code session on an exo-served model accumulates exo-runner memory per turn; a long multi-turn session can drive the machine into jetsam (macOS low-memory kills) affecting every other session on the host.
